w5-20_slippery_car.desc: AS 1743 W5-20 skidding car (national symbol reused for the 300 x 300 'black lettering and symbol' box)

notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/10/469B 'General warning sign detail W5-102' (2000). 900 x 1200, yellow retro-reflective with a 12 black edge line (drawn as the border), corner radius not stated (measured about 60). Red retro-reflective bands 75-275 and 985-1135 (outer chain 75/200/710/150/65) with white lettering; black lettering and symbol on the yellow. Vertical chain inside the edge line 235/150/45/300/105/105/170/90: WARNING bottom 235 (120 high, centred in the band: top 115), GRAVEL ROADS bottom 385 (top 325), symbol 430-730 (300 square, 300/300/300 across), SURFACE CONDITIONS bottom 835, CHANGE OFTEN bottom 940, DRIVE CAREFULLY bottom 1110 (75 high, centred in the lower band). Widths 80/745/75, 185/265/45/215/190, 70/310/45/410/65, 185/270/45/210/190, 65/235/50/490/60. Letter heights 60 / 75 / 120 and the series are not stated ('letters and numerals AS 1744'): Series C fits the 60/75 lines within 4-9% (D would be 10-15% wide), Series D the WARNING (D 684, E 804 against 745); heights from the chain and the drawn letters. The car symbol is the W5-20 artwork (the sheet draws the same skidding car) fitted in the 300 box.
